title: Seminaire de Geometrie Algebrique (SGA): English Translation Working Drafts
description:
Public SGA working-translation record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This version preserves the existing reader-facing PDFs, source-scan witnesses, and repair/source ZIPs while adding one compact SGA5 repair032 audit-support bundle: SGA5_repair032_audit_support_20260624.zip.

Status at a glance. This is a substantial working-draft and repair record, not a globally certified complete edition and not a critical edition. The SGA5 material is explicitly not complete and should be assumed to contain many remaining errors unless a later, narrower source-audit packet promotes a specific locus.

Current SGA5 audit caveat. A newer manual certification log demotes the agent/workflow passes to finder status rather than certification status. The current certified range is pp.1-15 (pp.1-12, p14, and p15 clean; p13 fixed with two source-fidelity corrections; p15 has a documented Type-B source typo handled in TeX), with p16 next. The broader local SGA5 live workpass remains important repair evidence: it reports 411 verified corrections, p1-p484 page-by-page French source-audit coverage in the live status note, and a 307-page PDF with no fatal/LaTeX-error diagnostics in the latest observed log scan. Remaining SGA5 publication/audit work includes final diff/FINDINGS refresh, compact packaging, independent validation, optional low-value prose-fidelity review where desired, and English synchronization. This proves that diagram errors and prose/symbol/functor-level errors remain in older global drafts and outside hand-certified loci. The current agent scorecard is useful but cautionary: in the hand-certified opening range it records 8 verified correct fixes, 1 partial/notation-imperfect fix, 1 miss, 0 false positives, and 0 botched fixes, with p13 showing that agents may catch a real functor error locally while failing to propagate the exact source notation across parallel occurrences.

New file in this version. SGA5_repair032_audit_support_20260624.zip bundles the local repair032 final packet, p205-p226 microaudit packet, remaining-error web-drop, README, and checksum manifest. The bundle is included so the current local repair/audit evidence is preserved in one slot on a record already at Zenodo file-count pressure.

File-surface curation note. The SGA record is at Zenodo's 100-file ceiling. This version removes the obsolete tiny sga_repair019_public_summary.json file from the latest file surface in order to add the repair032 audit-support bundle. Earlier versions preserve previous files.

Filename warning. Older filenames containing words such as Complete, Strict, Source-Checked, or High-Fidelity are legacy package names and are not current global certification claims. Source-witness and aid ZIPs are locator/check layers, not textual authority by themselves. Treat SGA6 and SGA7 as substantial working drafts with explicit compression/source-check caveats unless a specific later packet declares source-checked coverage.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
version: 2026-06-24 SGA5 repair032 audit-support bundle + 2026-06-25 hand-certification caveat reconciliation

The latest manual certification status only certifies pp.1-15 (pp.1-12, p14, and p15 clean; p13 fixed with two source-fidelity corrections; p15 has a documented Type-B source typo handled in TeX), with p16 next. The broader SGA5 status still reports 411 verified corrections, pp.1-484 reported audited locally in the live status note, and a clean fatal-error log scan, but remaining publication/audit work includes final diff/FINDINGS refresh, compact packaging, independent validation, optional low-value prose-fidelity review where desired, and English synchronization. The SGA5 branch is therefore still unpromoted, not independently certified, and not English-synchronized.
